text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tanino Gimlet's Senior Year
is finally about to begin—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today, I accompanied Tanino Gimlet and Vodka
on their Hatsumode visit...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: —Man, there really are a lot of people here.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh. Is that not splendid?
The multitude of people praying and wishing is proof that this current moment is steeped in chaos.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Perhaps it would be quite amusing if we too joined this pilgrimage's tide, to listen to our own desires' breath, commune with it, and carve it out...

――Oh my.
What a coincidence.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
To think I would run into an academy Umamusume
at such a place, at such a time.
And to think it would be... Tanino Gimlet-kun.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Umamusume I happened to bump into
were Agnes Tachyon and Daiwa Scarlet.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Daiwa Scarlet is an Umamusume often seen with Vodka.
They must be close friends.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And Agnes Tachyon is famous in more ways than one,
blessed with knowledge and curiosity far beyond a student,
along with a hint of suspiciousness.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh. That is my line, seeker of wisdom.
To think an entity cloaked in such madness as you would come for Hatsumode.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, that's quite harsh phrasing.
I too am a wholesome student. I visit a shrine for the New Year like anyone else.
If anything, I often hear that you are the mad one here, no?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: "Do not praise me so. It is precisely because I am aware of my own madness that I can grasp what is truly sacred."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Can't you do something about that peculiar phrasing?
Well, I suppose that is precisely the element
that makes you so delightfully mad, but—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"I don't... really get it,
but I feel like they're having a super cool conversation...!"

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Heheh, there's no way you could ever understand the depth behind Tachyon-san's words.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: The hell did you say?! You don't even understand Tan-senpai's cool-ass phrasing either!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
You say that, but do you really understand Gimlet-san's words?
You're just pretending to know, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Kh, sure, I might not understand all of it,
but your soul comes through loud and clear!!
That's what's so amazing about your words, Senpai!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Look who's talking! Tachyon-senpai's words were way over your head too, and you were frantically looking them up afterwards, weren't you?!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
O-Of course I do!! Tachyon-san's intellect is
way beyond mine, so it'd be rude not to prepare
this much just to have a conversation with her!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh... As expected of you, Vodka.
You understand my true intentions well.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I truly admire Scarlett-kun's eagerness
to learn. Respecting wisdom
makes things far less stressful, after all.

text_block_list.name: Gimlet & Tachyon
text_block_list.text: ...Mmh.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Don't underestimate Vodka's ability to see through to the core.
Sometimes, that brings about a stronger transformation
than a hundred lessons ever could.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Inspiration only comes from having a foundation of knowledge. Scarlet understands that and builds upon it. Underestimate that at your own peril.

text_block_list.name: Gimlet & Tachyon
choice_data_list: (Whoa, the tension's crackling all the way over here!?)

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: It seems I'll need to make a decision.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: This is something... that definitely needs to be proven.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
As a neutral third party, present us with
rules for a fair duel.
With that, Tachyon and I shall settle who is right.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: For some reason, I suddenly found myself having to arrange a duel to settle who was in the right. The first idea that came to mind wasâ

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Tachyon-san, that's amazing...!
This broth matches my taste perfectly...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I simply reverse-engineered it from your taste preferences.
Seasonings are logically easy to adjust, after all.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"Whoa, Gim-senpai, that's awesome!
What's with this daikon radish!?
Isn't the way you cut it super stylish!"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
These are the bounties of the earth I've encountered.
It would be a disgrace not to bring out their finest colors—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, we held a taste test
to compare the two pairs' ozoni, but—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As a judge, both options were truly
too close to call,
and it ultimately ended in a tie.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
This is the end!!
Take this!!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
No way!!
âSenpai!!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Leave it to me――――Hmph!!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I won't let you!
—Haaah!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: In the end, the rally continued until the sun went down, and with everyone collapsing from exhaustion at the same time... the battle concluded in a draw—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh, now is the hour of your ruin...!
Lie down and find your eternal rest beneath my "Sleepy Wave Card"!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Ohh, talk about perfect timing!
As expected of Gim-senpai!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Heh, already foresaw that—
I shall play the 'Decoy Doll Card'!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Incredible!
You foresaw this happening all the way back then...!?
As expected of you, Tachyon-san!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Afterward, we played against each other in various games until sundown, but with neither of us pulling ahead in wins, it ultimately ended in a draw...
